messages:
Leah (Billing): FYI INV-2026-11 from VoltMetrics — their dedicated commit lines show a $3,200 overage on L220. Customer says they were within committed capacity. Can ops confirm whether usage was misattributed or this is a billing calc issue?
Jordan (Revenue Ops): pulling usage report now. voltmetrics-prod:reserved-2026 commit size 1.5M tokens/month. Invoice shows burst usage 40,000 tokens billed at $0.08/token -> $3,200. running a quick reconcile against raw metering.
Priya (CS): VoltMetrics flagged this to their finance lead; they're holding payment pending resolution. customer is sensitive because they're ramping to dedicated next quarter. want a quick resolution.
Tom (Eng-Infra): there's an ingress tagging race we saw on 03/12 during a config push. Some requests landed on the ephemeral default pool and later got backfilled into the reserved pool; metering pipeline recorded them under 'burst' initially and didn't retroactively reclassify. opened INF-3412.
Leah (Billing): so sounds like we could reprocess and issue a credit. what's the exposure if we reclassify? any tax implications?
Accounting-bot: Reprocess candidate found: 40,000 tokens eligible for retroclassification. Estimated reclassification credit: $3,200. Note: credits > $2,500 require VP approval and GL memo.
Jordan (Revenue Ops): +1 to reclassify; preserve audit trail. will create a journal entry template.
Nora (VP Finance): tagging in. need GL note and CFO sight. What's the SLA angle? did VoltMetrics also experience degraded throughput?
Priya (CS): they reported degraded throughput for about 20 minutes during the tagging race window. SLA appendix B: latency SLO breach >15m -> 7% monthly service credit for affected class.
Leah (Billing): invoice snippet:
``
INV-2026-11 L220
product: dedicated-reserved
usage billed as burst: 40,000 tokens
rate: $0.08 / token
line_total: $3,200.00
```
Tom (Eng-Infra): infra can trigger retro-reclass and replay metering events. Reingest ETA 2h. INF-3412 assigned to me.
Nora (VP Finance): approve issuing reclassification credit up to $3,500 total (covers reclass + SLA). Please include ledger entry: "retro metering credit - tagging race 03/12" and mark as non-recurring.
Leah (Billing): thanks Nora. Jordan, can you generate CM ID and AR adjustments?
Jordan (Revenue Ops): generating CM... dry-run first -> CM-DRY-VM-03. Running final will create CM-2026-010. Also adding legal note for customer acknowledgement.
Accounting-bot: Dry-run complete. Estimated reclass credit: $3,200. Estimated SLA credit (7% pro-rated month): $224.00. Total estimated credit: $3,424.00. Command to apply: `/billing apply-credit --cm CM-2026-010 --ticket INF-3412`
Leah (Billing): @Nora final signoff for CM-2026-010?
Nora (VP Finance): confirm. approve CM-2026-010. please capture GL memo and route to audits@redwood.com.
Priya (CS): i'll draft the customer note: apology, explanation, CM attached, and assurance about deployment checks. want to offer a one-month monitoring credit if they'd like.
Tom (Eng-Infra): adding automated alert for mis-tagged requests and creating ENG-DEP-933 to require a metering smoke test post-deploy.
Jordan (Revenue Ops): applied CM-2026-010. AR updated and email sent to VoltMetrics billing contact. invoice INV-2026-11 adjusted. Marking ticket INF-3412 -> resolved after reingest completes.
Leah (Billing): closing loop: credit posted $3,424.00 (reclass $3,200 + SLA $224). customer ACK received. moving to closed. :white_check_mark:
Priya (CS): great, thanks team. saved to the customer file and noted for renewal negotiations. :thumbsup:
